purpose: Validation-only cross-dataset screen of the frozen AutoCon plus train-only ACF-memory selector, with exact selector-off control and strong same-source baselines.
research_question: Does the representation-conditioned ACF-memory selector improve the one-scan NLinearVariableMambaAutoCon model on METR-LA and PEMS-BAY at H12, while remaining competitive with strong nonlinear baselines?
architecture: NLinearVariableMambaAutoCon uses a shared NLinear forecast base, one Mamba-1 scan over variable tokens, a prediction-connected AutoCon representation, train-only ACF memory, and a zero-initialized rank-2 horizon plus rank-1 channel selector. The selector adds no Mamba scan.
evidence_boundary: All jobs use skip_test=true. No held-out test metrics are generated, read, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: A pass permits a separately registered held-out confirmation. This screen cannot establish universal superiority, causal AutoCon benefit, or a speed advantage.
prelaunch_gates: verify METR-LA and PEMS-BAY CSV and adjacency fingerprints
verify exact selector-on/off pairing and fresh seeds
verify candidate-only AutoCon relation settings are absent from external baselines
preserve skip_test=true and disable prediction artifacts for every job
run the immutable plan validator and resource preflight before any GPU launch

phases.name: selector_off_h12
phases.purpose: Exact selector-off control with frozen candidate-only AutoCon relation and ACF-memory settings.

phases.name: selector_on_h12
phases.purpose: One-factor selector treatment; only the representation-conditioned ACF-memory selector differs from control.

phases.name: external_context_h12
phases.purpose: Same-source validation context with candidate-only relation settings disabled.

pairing_contract.interpretation: The paired contrast isolates the selector inside the same AutoCon plus ACF-memory candidate; external models provide descriptive context only.

accuracy_gate.selector_vs_control: Selector-on must lower mean validation MSE on both datasets, win at least 2/3 paired seeds per dataset, and have no paired degradation above 2.0%.
accuracy_gate.external_context: Selector-on must be no worse than 2.0% relative to the best external-context model on each dataset before a held-out protocol is considered.
accuracy_gate.telemetry: Every selector-on job must report finite nonzero selector scale and a legal train-only observed lag.

comparison_contract.resource_gate: Only after an accuracy pass, benchmark exact-shape prediction-only resources; do not claim speed over DLinear or NLinear without a qualified separate analysis.

stopping_rules: Do not alter selector rank, initialization, relation loss, lag resolver, seeds, split, or budget after launch.
Stop before held-out test release if selector attribution or external-context accuracy gate fails.
Do not read or generate held-out test metrics in this screen.
